dialogues.speaker: Galina
dialogues.text: Please pay close attention to your surroundings, and notify me immediately if you see anything unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Galina
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. While I truly wish to answer your question, doing so does not fall within the ambit of my duties. All I am responsible for is the handling of unusual situations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing unusual found in the surroundings as of now.

dialogues.speaker: Galina
dialogues.text: Alright then. Thank you for your cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What exactly are your duties, then?

dialogues.speaker: Galina
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I am not obliged to inform you of the scope of my duties either. That is confidential.
